# Env-gated rigs that CI RUNS but does not GATE on, each against an open bead.
#
# Read by scripts/rigcensus (make check). Format: ENV_VAR  # BEAD: <id> reason
#
# QUARANTINE IS NOT A LOOSER EXEMPTION AND MUST NOT BORROW ITS VOCABULARY.
#   exempt      = CI does not run it at all. The trigger says when a human does.
#   quarantined = CI RUNS it on every push, the failure is visible in the log,
#                 and the build's verdict ignores it.
# They answer different questions. Collapsing them would turn the exemption
# file into the place failing rigs go to be forgotten, which is the precise
# thing that file exists to prevent.
#
# WHAT MAKES THIS HONEST RATHER THAN A HOLE: every entry names a bead, and the
# census FAILS THE BUILD when that bead is missing or closed. A quarantine
# therefore cannot outlive its ticket silently. A plain temporary exemption has
# no such property, which is why one was refused here (super's ruling on
# ini-0lko). The bead check runs wherever bd is available -- `make check`, which
# every commit passes through via the pre-commit hook. CI runners have no beads
# database, so there the census says out loud that it could not verify, rather
# than printing OK for a check that did not run.
#
# A quarantined rig MUST still be wired into CI (env block AND -run selector).
# The census fails if it is not: a quarantined rig nobody runs is an exemption
# in disguise, and its failure would be invisible, which defeats the point.

INITECH_9GVN  # BEAD: ini-8mrq — fails on ubuntu runners: respawned pane alive, unsuspended, zero bytes captured. Passes on macOS and locally on darwin. Runs here so the signature stays visible while 8mrq is open.
INITECH_9IMX  # BEAD: ini-8mrq — same signature, same resume path; this is the rig whose first linux run ever produced the finding. Not a regression: it had never run on linux before ini-0lko wired it.
